name: Typewriter
summary: Manual typewriter with a sheet of paper on the platen and rows of keys; use for writers, office and retro scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the feet rest on y; set y to a desk top to place it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the typewriter is about 660 px wide (desk size)

params.name: anim
params.note: type = lines of text appear on the paper and a key dips

author: krakujs
